messages:
noah_finance: Aurelia Systems says their April invoice showed the support plan as $0.00 and they got two PDFs with the same invoice number INV-2024-04-1024. Can someone triage?

lina_billing: I pulled the records: invoice_total=USD 18,752.00, but we archived two different PDFs. PDF A shows the support line; PDF B shows support=0.00.

billing-bot: invoice_export: warning invoice_id=INV-2024-04-1024 export_attempt=2 checksum_mismatch=true partial_export=true

ops-jen: Renderer used pricing_snapshot where experiment_flag=beta_support_pricing. That snapshot had price_override=0.00 for some tenants due to a cache warmup failure in the experiments service.

sre-ryan: There was a rollout yesterday at 03:00 UTC. Cache fallback returned zeroed overrides for a subset. Export retries are not idempotent, so the retry re-rendered with bad snapshot.

lina_billing: Stripe shows a single charge ch_3JxYkR for USD 18,752.00 at 2024-04-02T09:14:22Z, so the customer wasn't double-charged.

tara_cs: Customer wants confirmation no incorrect charge happened and a corrected PDF. They'll hold AP until we confirm.

noah_finance: Actions: 1) remove the incorrect PDF from public bucket, 2) pin renderer to invoice.price_snapshot_id at render time, 3) revert experiment rollout and add cache fallback tests.

lina_billing: Created FIN-4899: "pricing-experiment cache fallback causes zeroed support line + non-idempotent export leads to duplicate PDFs". Assigning to billing-engine + experiments.

sre-ryan: Deploying renderer hotfix to read price_snapshot_id and make export idempotent. Target 11:00 UTC.

ops-jen: Temporary mitigations: set export_retry_policy=manual for invoices created between 2024-04-02T09:00:00Z and 2024-04-02T09:30:00Z. Running query: `select invoice_id from invoice_exports where created_at between '2024-04-02T09:00:00Z' and '2024-04-02T09:30:00Z' and export_attempts>1;`

tara_cs: I'll send the customer a note: payment was for the correct amount, corrected PDF to follow, offer 5% goodwill credit.

noah_finance: Approve up to USD 100 credit without further signoff. Ops, please push a postmortem after deploy.

billing-bot: deploy: renderer v2.5.1-hotfix scheduled for 11:00 UTC. Changes: fix(export): idempotent export marking; fix(renderer): honor invoice.price_snapshot_id during render

ops-jen: Will follow up with affected-customer list; early estimate ~12 invoices across two tenants.

tara_cs: Thanks team. Customer happy payment was correct, will wait for final PDF and note. :thumbsup:
